text: Objectives This program is designed to bring up senior specialized financial talents who possess good basic knowledge and financial theories, methods and application skills of modern finance. Graduates should be qualified for positions of research and management in relevant departments of financial firms, bank, securities, insurance and other institutions. Students would also been exposed to China's politics, economy and culture so that they could participate in and contribute to friendly exchanges and cooperation between China and their home countries. Duration 4 years Medical Insurance: h
